doc.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

chapter: Army and return to Kansas City
title: Back in Kansas City: Dave Dexter's session and losing the band book
summary: On returning from service he joined Dave Dexter's recording session, and the band's book of arrangements was lost, forcing a restart.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: What was the musical scene like in Kansas City at that time?
Well the day that I got back to Kansas City it was Dave Dexter was recording so it was, he was in Kansas City recording and I got in on that.
Oh, okay. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -4-
So then after he found out I’d gotten in town, then he had me do some things there at that time.
When was it that you got to put your own band together?

Well I lost that book see. The book that I had at that time, somebody came down to the auditorium the next morning and picked the book up. And I never did hear any more about the book. So I had to start out with trying to get another book together. So that was it. A hit and a run, a hit and a miss you know.
